status: follow-up after the deep MI audit; exploratory; not part of the MB12 lock
points: resid_pre_0, resid_post_0..3 and mlp_hidden_0..3, at the scored position
edits: role swap (a role value of another role, seed 0)
previous action, possession change and time gap: each set to the MB02 donor's value
whole context with all four identity inputs written back
identity_subspace: top-r uncentred SVD of the stacked player-removal and player-swap difference vectors (discovery)
context_subspace: top-r uncentred SVD of the whole-context difference vectors (discovery)
overlap_baselines: norm-matched random-vector subspace vs the context subspace
overlap_reading: (rank 4, the only rank with match-resampled intervals) identity and context overlap beyond chance at a point if the identity-context overlap CI low exceeds the 95th percentile of random subspaces AND the random-vector-context overlap
projection_ranks: r90: for each subspace, the smallest rank holding 90 per cent of its edit's squared change (capped at half the width); random controls get the larger of the two ranks
projection_reading: at a point and rank: SEPARABLE if removing the identity subspace retains <= 0.5 of the identity effect and >= 0.8 of the context effect, removing the context subspace retains <= 0.5 of the context effect and >= 0.8 of the identity effect, and the random subspace retains >= 0.8 of both; SHARED if either subspace retains <= 0.5 of both effects; otherwise MIXED
units: eta-squared of every MLP hidden unit for identity variables (player within role, role, team) and context variables (previous action, previous outcome, possession change, time gap quintile, x third, coupled flag, score difference, minute bin); threshold per variable = 99th percentile of eta-squared with labels shuffled (20 shuffles); all P-player validation events

unit_classes.E: identity and at least 3 context variables (broadly mixed)

top_units: 20 per layer with the largest |mean attribution| of the identity effect: (h - h_removed) x dDelta/dh, discovery half
identity_conditioned_context: cosine and norm ratio of the context-induced difference vector with player A vs with partner B, and vs a fixed norm-matched random vector
mlp_split: each MLP's output at the scored position split into its part in the rank-4 identity subspace of that layer and the rest; direct logit attribution of each part to Delta (final LayerNorm scale frozen); random rank-4 split as baseline
sae_rule: an SAE is justified only if ALL hold: (i) more than half of the top identity-effect units are class C or E; (ii) identity and context overlap beyond chance (overlap_reading) at one or more resid_post points; (iii) projection is not SEPARABLE at any resid_post point and rank
